title.narrative: Strengthening TVTO: Empowerment of Crisis Affected Women Through AI and Digitalization

description.narrative: In a disaster-stricken setting, women are among the most vulnerable groups, requiring support and assistance to resume and recover their livelihoods. In line with the UNDP’s Leave No One Behind (LNOB) agenda and in order to mitigate the impacts of crisis on women, it is essential to empower their capacities and enhance their resilience through different means including up-to-dated trainings (with a focus on digitalization and AI) and employment opportunities. To achieve this, it is required to strengthen the capacity of the Technical and Vocational Training Organization (TVTO), affiliated to the Ministry of Cooperative, Labour, and Social Welfare (MCLSW), as the custodian organization for vocational trainings nationwide. The cooperation between UNDP, MCLSW, and TVTO for women empowerment will consist of three main components including:• Providing training for TVTO trainers as well as development of standard training content and material on AI and digitalization• Improvement of women target group’s capacity on AI/digitalization and provision of required facilitation for joining the marketplace• Development of a roadmap on mainstreaming AI in TVTO’s trainingFirst and foremost, this initiative is expected to enhance the capacities of TVTO trainers on how to leverage AI and other digital tools for different professions and skills, which enables transfer of practical knowledge to the target groups.Additionally, this initiative expects to provide the required training facilities for the beneficiaries, ensuring that the trainees benefit from the necessary setting for advancing their professional skills.Ultimately, the above activities will lead to mentoring target groups on AI/digitalization and employment facilitation for joining digital marketplaces. A roadmap on mainstreaming AI in TVTO’s training will be developed.Iran is among the countries in which the rate of higher degree education for women is almost the same or in some cases even surpassed that of men.
